messages.text: I love you. A little more than yesterday, actually.
I can just be myself with you. I love that about us.
I was thinking about you just now and caught myself smiling.
Home is wherever you are.
I'm really glad you exist.
Even folding laundry is fun with you.
I'd pick you again in a heartbeat.
Your laugh is my favorite sound.
My favorite place in the world is next to you on the couch.
I love you. No reason, I just do.
One thought of you and my day's already better.
I think I got really lucky with you.
Everything's been a little easier since you showed up.
I like us. A lot.
My whole day's plan is getting back to you tonight.
I like you on good days and tired days.
Your name on my screen gets me every single time.
Nobody else I'd rather grow old with.
You're my favorite person. Just wanted you to know.
Love you. Seriously, a lot.
I see how much you give. I don't take it for granted.
Thanks for sticking around, even when I'm hard work.
The little things you do mean a lot to me.
I'm proud of you. Don't think I say it enough.
You get me without me having to explain.
I like how honest you are with me.
You actually listen. Do you know how rare that is?
I can count on you. I should say that more.
I love how you treat people.
It's been a while since I told you how much you matter to me.
You try so hard. I notice.
I can talk to you about anything. Thank you for that.
You stay calm when I'm panicking. It really helps.
I love how you stand up for what matters to you.
You take me as I am. I know that's not a given.
I like who I am with you.
Thanks for always making time for me.
Love how you keep going when it gets tough.
You always know when I need you. How do you do that?
Glad I've got you. Today especially.
Good morning. Hope you slept well.
Morning! Drinking my first coffee to you.
You were my first thought when I woke up.
Morning. I'm staying in bed five more minutes, thinking of you.
Good morning. Consider this text your friendliest alarm.
Have a good day. And eat something real for breakfast.
Hope your day is kinder than your alarm clock.
Morning, sleepyhead. Or early bird. Love you either way.
It's gray out there, but I'm looking forward to tonight.
Quick hello before your first coffee: you've got this.
Hope your morning starts as nicely as mine did, thinking of you.
Morning. Take a jacket, it's freezing.
Just woke up and wanted to say hi.
New day, and I've got you. That's plenty.
Rise and shine. Text me when you're up.
Morning, you. See you later, can't wait.
Wishing you good moods and very few meetings today.
Good morning. Today's going to be a good one, I can feel it.
Don't skip breakfast. I mean it.
Have a lovely day. I'm thinking of you.
Good night. Sleep tight and dream something nice.
Putting my phone down now. My last thought is yours.
Long day. Go get some rest.
Night, you. I wish I were next to you right now.
Close your eyes. I'm right there with you in my head.
Sleep well. Tomorrow I get another day with you.
I'm tired and happy. That's your doing.
Get cozy. Sending you a hug through the phone.
Leave the worries outside. They'll still be there tomorrow.
Sleep well. I love you.
Goodnight, my favorite person.
Before I fall asleep: thanks for today.
Hope you sleep deep and long tonight.
Good night, see you tomorrow. Already looking forward to it.
The bed's way too big without you. Come home soon.
Sleep well. I'll be first in line for you tomorrow.
You did great today. Good night.
One kiss for the night. Sleep well.
One last thought of you, and now I can sleep.
Good night. You're the best part of my day.
You've got this. I'm sure of it.
One thing at a time. That's plenty for today.
It's okay that it's hard right now. I'm here.
You've handled worse than this. You'll handle this too.
Take a breath. You're doing better than you think.
However it turns out, I'm proud of you.
It doesn't have to be perfect. You're enough for me.
Want to talk tonight? Or just sit together quietly? Either works.
You're stronger than you feel today.
Chin up. I've got your back.
Everyone slips up. You're still really good at this.
Take a break. You've earned it.
Fingers crossed for you today.
I'm on your side, whatever happens.
Tomorrow will look different. It usually does.
Everyone doubts sometimes. Giving up just isn't your style.
I don't know anyone who'd handle this better than you.
Let's make tonight a really good evening.
Go for it. I'm right here with you.
You've done more than you give yourself credit for.
I miss you.
Can't wait to see you again.
Counting the hours until I see you.
Out of nowhere in the middle of the day, I miss you.
I'd love to be on the couch with you right now. Blanket and all.
Counting the hours until you're back.
Just saw something funny and wanted to tell you right away.
Come home soon. I miss your face.
Quick hello from far away: I miss you quite a bit.
I can still hear your laugh in my head.
When do I get to hug you again?
Funny how I miss you after just two days.
Every time my phone buzzes, I hope it's you.
I miss our ordinary little routines.
The walk home is only half as nice without you.
I'm wearing your hoodie. It smells like you.
See you soon. Until then I'll just keep missing you.
Half my day is missing without you.
No big reason. I just miss you.
Call me when you can. I want to hear your voice.
You look amazing today. Again.
Your smile got me back then, and it still does.
You're ridiculously smart, you know that?
You make other people happy without trying. Me too.
I love how you laugh when you think nobody's watching.
You're genuinely funny. I mean it.
That look you give me gets me every time.
You've got a big heart. Anyone can see it.
I love how you stay true to yourself.
You look just as good in sweatpants as in a suit.
Your sense of humor is my favorite distraction.
You're a really good listener. I love that.
I don't think you realize how great you are.
Your voice calms me down right away.
You've got style without even trying.
I can't think of anyone as warm as you.
When you laugh, I forget everything else for a second.
You're braver than you think.
I'm still surprised by how much you can do.
Oh, and you're pretty cute too.
I love you. Almost as much as pizza.
You're my favorite person. The couch is a close second.
We go together like cheese and more cheese.
In case you were wondering if I think about you: yes. Constantly.
My phone's at 3 percent. My love for you is at 100.
You can cook tonight if you like. I'll handle the compliments.
Sending you a kiss. Please catch it.
You're my favorite person on the whole couch.
Thought about dinner yet? I have. Since breakfast.
Without you my life would be only half as chaotic.
I wanted to write something romantic, but all I had was a coffee joke.
Without you, I'd have to laugh at my own jokes.
You stole the blanket again, didn't you? Forgiven anyway.
I was so busy daydreaming about you that I missed my bus stop.
Too tired for compliments. Never too tired for you.
I only put up with your remote control dictatorship because I love you.
You had me at snacks.
I saved you in my phone as my emergency contact for good moods.
My heart is working overtime because of you.
You're the reason I grin at my phone like a goofball.
Thank you for everything you did for me today.
Thanks for listening. It really helped.
Thanks for being there when I needed you.
That was so sweet of you. Thank you, truly.
Your message made my day. Thank you.
Thanks for cooking. And for the dishes, even more.
Thanks for thinking of me.
I couldn't have done it without you. Thank you.
Thanks for being so patient with me.
I won't forget how you had my back.
Thanks for a lovely evening. I really enjoyed it.
You saved my day today. Thank you.
Thanks for making me laugh when I really didn't feel like it.
Thanks for the hug. It was exactly what I needed.
Glad you're by my side. Thank you for that.
Thanks for all the small things you do. I notice every one.
Thanks for never letting me down.
Thanks for your help. I owe you one.
That breakfast was the best surprise. Thank you.
Thank you for being you. Really.
I'm sorry. You mean so much to me.
I'm sorry. I hope you can forgive me.
I'm sorry for earlier. I care about you so much.
I've been thinking, and you were right. I'm sorry.
You mean the world to me. I'm so sorry.
Sorry about earlier. You matter to me.
Can we talk? I'm really sorry.
I should have listened better. I'm sorry.
You matter more to me than being right.
I'm sorry. Let me make it up to you.
I'm sorry I kept you waiting.
I want us to be good. I'm sorry.
That's not what I meant to say. Please forgive me.
I'll do better. I promise.
I'm sorry. I'd like to make it right.
I've been thinking about it since this morning. You deserve better from me.
I'm sorry I wasn't more present. I'm here now.
I get now how that came across. I'm sorry.
Can we start over? I'm ready to listen.
Sorry. I love you, even when I don't show it well.
